source_scope.rank_vector_semantics: For each target, rank vector contains predicted rank of each of the five actual sorted draw numbers; vector index 0..4 maps P1..P5 (ascending).

method: Position-wise screen of the retrospective oracle-best formula and per-family best formula rank vectors in Q90 target ledger. Calculate top-5 rank rate, mean predicted rank, and top-1 rate for each sorted position separately by chronological split. This is an oracle-conditioned diagnostic, NOT an ex-ante formula selector or a position-specific formula validation.

screen_decision.why: P5 shows the strongest oracle-conditioned top-5 and top-1 rank rates and lowest mean rank in blind OOS; interaction family I4 shows consistent P5 advantage relative to other positions.
screen_decision.not_claimed: No demonstrated prospective predictive edge. The oracle formula is chosen retrospectively after outcome knowledge; P5 also has an intrinsically different order-statistic distribution. Position difficulty cannot be concluded solely from this diagnostic.

important_gap.finding: Q90 target ledger does not preserve each of the 330,429 formulas' five per-target number ranks. It preserves the oracle-best formula rank vector and per-family best formula rank vectors only.
important_gap.next_required: Create a complete formula-target-position ledger or evaluate formula scores against the historical sorted actuals for each target; keep formula selection strictly prior-only with nested walk-forward. Rank positions based on the ex-ante selected formulas, not oracle rows. Then analyze P5 residual misses and test residual rules in held-out temporal blocks.

integrity.leakage_safe_claim: Not applicable to oracle diagnostic; target split is chronological but oracle-best selection uses hindsight.
